# ADR-0040 — S1.5c Session A build findings

## Status
Proposed

## Date
2026-09-12

## Slice
S1.5c

## Context
Kind: addition
- Spec says: `docs/build/06-decisions/ADR-0039-project-editor-v2-slice.md` D4 — "`lib/markdown.ts` loses its `server-only` marker (its renderer has no server dependency — react-markdown + remark-gfm + rehype-sanitize + `next/image`)"; D5 — "list / quote / link / image / video glyphs from the existing `Icon` set"; D3 — "A click on another section while dirty opens a `Dialog`"; `docs/build/01-architecture.md` INV-86 — "`@/lib/markdown` banned in `components/**` client files"; `docs/build/03-components.md` §2.10 `MarkdownEditor` row — "write · preview · disabled" without saying which control survives for a moderator; ADR-0039 *Docs amended* — 03 "island-list paths added at Session A", 05 §8 "IDs at Session A".
- Found (Session A build pass, branch `feat/S1.5c-project-editor-v2`): (1) `lib/markdown.ts` imported `env` from `@/lib/env` for the Supabase image host — a server dependency D4 missed, and INV-87 bans `@/lib/env` from `'use client'` files and everything they import; (2) `components/primitives/Icon.tsx` had none of the six glyph names D5 assumed; (3) Next soft navigation never fires `beforeunload`, so a guard limited to the section links would let the admin shell's own nav and in-page links discard edits silently; (4) INV-86's `components/**` ban contradicted D4's "one client importer" without naming the file; (5) 03 §2.10 disables "every field, toolbar button and Save" for a moderator, but a view-only Preview writes nothing and lets a moderator read the description as it renders; (6) the island's mount-time `FormData` snapshots must belong to the section on screen, which a re-render with new children does not guarantee.
- Related: the bookkeeping ADR-0039 left to Session A is closed in this PR — the three island rows in 03 §1.4, the 03 §9 `--scrim` row, the 05 §8 S1.5c IDs (T-UNIT-52, 53; T-E2E-55, 56, 57; T-E2E-34/35/42/51/53/54 amended in place) and `scripts/check-test-ids.mjs`; `docs/questions.md` "Oliver's second-use list (2026-09-12)"; no Q<nn>; supersedes nothing.

## Decision
1. **`lib/markdown.ts` reads `publicEnv`, not `env`.** The file carries no `import 'server-only'`; it imports `{ publicEnv } from '@/lib/env/public'` (never `@/lib/env`) and derives `SUPABASE_HOST` as `new URL(publicEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL).hostname`. Nothing else in the file changes — renderer, `rehype-sanitize` schema, `urlTransform`, image allowlist, heading demotion (05 T-UNIT-14 unchanged). Only `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` names can reach the admin client bundle through it (01 INV-29 / INV-87).
2. **`Icon` gains six names.** `components/primitives/Icon.tsx` `ICON_NAMES` += `list`, `list-ordered`, `quote`, `link`, `image`, `video` — 24-grid, 2px stroke, square caps like the existing glyphs. `MarkdownEditor` renders its non-text toolbar glyphs from these (`MARKDOWN_COMMANDS[].glyph.kind === 'icon'`), never from inline SVG of its own. The `Icon` `size` union gains `18` (type-only — `16 | 18 | 20 | 24`; no new CSS): the toolbar renders its icon glyphs at 18px.
3. **The leave guard intercepts every same-document link click while dirty.** `components/admin/EditorSections.tsx` registers one document-level `click` listener in the capture phase. While dirty, a plain left click (`button === 0`, no modifier keys) on an `<a href>` that would navigate this window (same origin, no `target="_blank"`, no `download`, href differing from the current URL beyond a hash) is `preventDefault()`ed + `stopPropagation()`ed and opens `Dialog` — title "Unsaved changes", body "You changed something here and didn't save.", Stay (primary, default, Esc) / Leave anyway (ghost). Leave anyway clears the dirty ref (so `beforeunload` stays silent), closes the dialog and `router.push(href)`. The section links are the primary case; the admin shell's nav and in-page links are covered by the same listener. Modifier clicks, `target="_blank"`, downloads, cross-origin links and hash-only changes pass through. `beforeunload` (hard navigation, close, reload) stays as ADR-0039 D3 wrote it and is removed when clean.
4. **INV-86 names the one client importer.** `components/primitives/MarkdownEditor.tsx` is the only `'use client'` file that may import `@/lib/markdown` (for `renderMarkdown()` in the Preview); the `components/**` ban stays for every other file; `react-markdown` / `remark-gfm` / `rehype-sanitize` are still imported by `lib/markdown.ts` only; `components/primitives/Markdown.tsx` stays a Server Component (03 `S`) and imports nothing from those packages. With `import 'server-only'` gone the build no longer stops a stray client import, so `eslint.config.mjs` carries the fence (Session B): `@/lib/markdown` is a restricted import in `components/**` and in the three browser-client seams (`CommentThread` — INV-66), with `Markdown.tsx` and `MarkdownEditor.tsx` the only exceptions.
5. **The Preview toggle stays enabled for a moderator.** With `disabled` (moderator), `MarkdownEditor` renders the textarea `disabled`, every toolbar button `disabled` + `title="Admin only"` and the page's Save disabled (03 §2.10 rule; 00 S1.5c.AC6), but the Preview `Toggle` remains operable — view only, nothing writable, nothing posted. The page therefore renders the editor without the `title="Admin only"` wrapper span the other moderator controls get (Session B): the textarea and the toolbar buttons carry the title themselves, and a wrapper would label the live toggle "Admin only" too.
6. **`EditorSections` remounts per section.** `app/admin/projects/[id]/page.tsx` renders `<EditorSections key={section} …>` so a section change remounts the island and its mount-time `FormData` snapshots are taken from the forms now on screen; the island carries `data-dirty="true"` on its root while dirty (an e2e / CSS hook, not a `data-state` value).
7. **The Description section Save posts the Body verbatim.** `app/admin/projects/[id]/page.tsx` `saveBody` sends `body_md` as the string typed (`String(formData.get('body_md') ?? '')`; empty allowed by `bodyMdSchema` in `lib/actions/projects.schema.ts`), so saving an emptied Body clears it. The General form keeps its `orUndefined` partial-update semantics for its own fields (`saveDetails`, `saveOverrides`). Why: a one-field section whose Save says "Saved." while keeping the old text would lie (03 C-30 spirit). No contract change — `updateExclusiveProject` already accepts an empty `body_md`.
8. **`?listing=<id>` without `?section=` opens the Listings section.** On `/admin/projects/[id]` of an **odsens** row a `?listing=` query with no valid `?section=` resolves `section` to `listings` (an explicit, valid `?section=` wins; without `?listing=` the unknown / not-in-list → `general` rule applies); a synced row ignores `?listing=` — its Modrinth field is read-only, so there is nothing to prefill; the `/admin/projects` match-note ghost link carries `?section=listings&listing=<external_id>` explicitly (`app/admin/projects/page.tsx`), so the prefill lands on the section that renders the Modrinth field either way.
9. **Script-committed edits announce themselves as native events.** React commits a state-driven value by property assignment, which fires no `input` / `change`, so the delegated listeners of D3's dirty tracker would miss it. `components/primitives/MarkdownEditor.tsx` dispatches a bubbling `input` on its textarea after every toolbar / Ctrl/Cmd+B/I command commits (in the selection-restore effect — React's value tracker already holds the value, so its own `onChange` does not re-fire); `components/primitives/Select.tsx` dispatches a bubbling `change` on its hidden `<input name>` after a pick commits. Additive (03 C-03): no prop changes; the stored values are unchanged. Why: a toolbar-only edit (select a word, Bold) or a Type change alone left the section clean — no dot, no dialog, the edit lost on a section click (00 S1.5c.AC2/AC3). The textarea's shortcut handler also ignores Shift chords (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+B/I are the browser's — bookmarks bar, devtools), as it already ignored Alt.
10. **A form is snapshotted on `focusin`, before its first edit; a clean one is re-based only when its field set changed.** `EditorSections` snapshots a form when focus enters it if the form is untracked (it appeared after mount — the gallery names form a first upload creates through `router.refresh()`); a tracked form is re-based only while the island is clean AND its set of field names differs from the snapshot's (rows an upload added or removed — not an edit). A value change alone never re-bases (a script-committed edit whose native event follows a focus move — the Markdown toolbar refocusing its textarea, D9 — must still read dirty), and a form with edits pending is never touched. Why: the mount-only snapshot missed the first keystroke on a form born after mount and read a grown form as unsaved after any keystroke (a needless Leave dialog). Not e2e-asserted (upload-then-type in one page-life); T-E2E-55/56's clean / dirty assertions cover the unchanged paths and the toolbar case.
11. **The active chip is scrolled into view on mount (Session B).** Below 900px `EditorSections` sets the chip row's `scrollLeft` so `a[aria-current="page"]` lies inside the row (never `scrollIntoView` — the page must not scroll). Why: the per-section remount (D6) returns the row to its left edge, which left the Listings chip clipped and the Publish chip off-screen at 390 — no visible chip looked selected. DESIGN.md v1.10 §11.3 #20 says so now; T-E2E-57 asserts it. The chip is also the containing block (`position: relative`) of its visually-hidden "Unsaved changes" label, which otherwise resolved against the viewport and widened the page while unsaved (design-fidelity gate, Session B; 00 S1.5c.AC5).
12. **The toolbar's 44px target holds on touch; a mouse at ≥900px gets 40×44 in-group (Session B — David, 2026-09-17).** 36px buttons on the designed 4px pitch cannot each own a 44px-wide target: the `::after` boxes of in-group neighbours overlap, and an overlap belongs to neither (WCAG "target"). The frontend gate failed the item twice, so the choice went to David (START-BUILD step 4), who picked the touch-only spacing: below 900px or with `pointer: coarse` the in-group gap is 8px and every button owns a full 44×44 (`::after` `inset: -4px`); with a fine pointer at ≥900px the 4px pitch of DESIGN.md v1.10 §11.3 #20 stays, the `::after` reaches 4px above / below and past a group's outer sides and 2px into each in-group gap — an even split, 40×44. Wrapped rows sit 8px apart at every width. This is the one accepted exception to 03 C-24, scoped to this admin-only toolbar with a mouse. T-E2E-57 probes every side of every button at 390 and 1280.

## Alternatives considered
| Alternative | Why not |
|---|---|
| Keep `import { env } from '@/lib/env'` in `lib/markdown.ts` and pass the Supabase host into `renderMarkdown()` as a parameter | Changes the renderer's signature for every caller and the 03 `Markdown` row; the host is a `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` value already, so `publicEnv` is the INV-87 answer with no API change. |
| A second, client-only renderer module for the Preview | Two renderers = two sanitize schemas to keep equal; ADR-0039 D4's point is one renderer (00 S1.5c.AC4 "same renderer, same sanitize schema"). |
| Inline SVG glyphs inside `MarkdownEditor` instead of extending `Icon` | Breaks the one-`Icon`-set reuse rule (03 §1.5) and DESIGN.md v1.10's "glyphs from the existing `Icon` set"; six names in `ICON_NAMES` is the smaller change. |
| Guard only the section links (an `onClick` on each `next/link` in the island) | The admin shell's Projects / Comments / Settings links and in-page links would discard edits without a word — Next soft navigation never fires `beforeunload`; David asked for the dialog whenever edits would be lost. |
| Wrap `next/navigation`'s router so every soft navigation is guarded | Reaches into framework internals; a document-level capture listener is plain DOM, testable (T-E2E-55) and removed on unmount. |
| Disable the Preview toggle for moderators along with everything else | Nothing to protect (a read-only render of a value the moderator already sees); the toggle lets a moderator check a description as it will render. |
| Keep `orUndefined` on `body_md` in `saveBody` (the General form's partial-update rule) | A one-field section whose Save says "Saved." while the old text stays would lie (03 C-30 spirit); the General form has many fields and keeps the rule, the Description section has one. |
| Leave `?listing=` on `general` and rely on the match note's `?section=listings` alone | A pasted or bookmarked `?listing=` link would prefill a field on a section not on screen; resolving the section from `?listing=` costs one line and keeps the explicit `?section=` in charge. |
| Let `EditorSections` also recompute on a `click` inside `[role="option"]` instead of `Select` dispatching `change` | Misses the keyboard pick paths (Enter / Space / type-ahead) and couples the tracker to one primitive's DOM; a native `change` from the hidden input is what any listener already expects. |
| Snapshot an untracked form inside the `input` handler only (no `focusin`) | The `input` event fires after the value changed, so the baseline already holds the first keystroke and that edit never shows the dot. |
| 8px between toolbar buttons at every width (a full 44×44 everywhere, no exception) | At 1280 the toolbar grows 558 → 594px and pushes the Preview control onto its own row in the 720px column (strip 54 → 94px) — a visible change to the designed desktop toolbar for a pointer that does not need it. David's call. |
| Keep the 4px pitch everywhere and log 40px as the target | Leaves touch — where the 44px rule matters — short on the phone rows too. |
| Reset the island's snapshots in an effect keyed on `active` instead of `key={section}` | Effects run after the new forms paint and race the delegated listeners; a remount is the simpler guarantee that snapshots and forms belong to the same section. |

## Consequences
- Positive: the Preview renders through the one site renderer without a server module in the client bundle; every route out of a dirty section (section links, admin nav, in-page links, hard navigation) asks first; the six glyphs are reusable by later admin UI; INV-86 and 03 now name the one exception, so the gates have a file to check against.
- Negative: a document-level click listener runs on every click while the editor island is mounted (it returns at once when clean); `Icon` grows by six glyphs on every route that imports it (tiny); the admin editor route's client bundle carries the Markdown renderer (ADR-0039 Consequences: ~40–60 KB gz, admin only) — measured on the PR build (01 INV-80): `/admin/projects/[id]` First Load JS +48.8 kB gz in the PR body, +50.2 kB gz by the frontend gate's method (168.5 → 218.6 kB gz); no other route moved by more than 1 kB gz.
- Known limits (Session B — not guarded in this slice): the browser's Back button while unsaved leaves without asking (a `popstate` is neither a link click nor an unload); every submit's PRG re-renders the whole section from the server (observed on the production build: the island remounts clean and every form resets, even when the redirect URL is unchanged), so (a) an edit typed in ANOTHER form of the section is dropped when one form is submitted — Listings has two — and (b) the text typed into a REFUSED save is not echoed back. Both are follow-ups in `docs/questions.md`.
- Follow-ups: DESIGN.md v1.10 §11.3 #20 names the six glyphs and `--scrim` (same PR — `design-fidelity`); the `pnpm build` route-size line for `/admin/projects/[id]` goes in the PR body (`web-quality` / `frontend-reviewer`); Session B flips this ADR to Accepted at merge (`keep-docs`).
